contract.carriers: Native public Optional/Result types, constructors, queries, copy/move and matching; canonical semantic type guards.
contract.errors: Explicit checked calls, typed throws and local handlers; nested evaluated throwing calls require their own checked form.
contract.optionalization: Always adds one outer Optional, preserving successful absence.
contract.ownership: Qualified ARC active-arm operations through ordinary/runtime calls, captures, records, arrays and heap storage; callable widening preserves managed result lifetime.
contract.packages: Exact SDK seal and explicit language/standard/ownership identities; source-free immutable consumers.
contract.cutover: Extension ABI 13; rebuild objects, PCH, interfaces and packages.

installed_source_modules.limits: Example module graph, not a general package manager. Build timings exclude full SDK admission and final verification; elapsed timings include both. The native linker runs on every invocation.
